title: Poles.
officialText:
Wooden scaffold poles shall be plumb and the foot ends shall be secured against lateral movement. Where
wood poles are spliced, the squared end of the upper section shall bear uniformly on the squared end of the lower section and the
two ends shall be rigidly fastened together with two or more wood splice plates, each at least 4 feet (1219 mm) in length. The
plates shall be placed at right angles to each other, shall overlap the abutting ends of the pole equally, and shall have a combined
sectional area not less than 50 percent of the cross sectional area of the pole. Splicing of adjacent poles shall be staggered.
Splices shall be close to ledgers, but so located as not to interfere with the fastenings.
